{{Quote|The best wine comes from, well, it doesn't matter. Jabba won't drink the best wine. He has a taste for this Corellian Merlot.|[[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]]|<ref name="SWG:JPP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Porcellus|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Corellian Merlot''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime boss [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] had a taste for this [[Merlot/Legends|merlot]], though his chef [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] felt it was not the best type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]].<ref name="SWG:JPP" /> It was also served in the dining car of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''.<ref name="GoA">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This drink was mentioned by the NPC Porcellus in one of his quests in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which are part of Jabba's Theme Park.<ref name="SWG:JPP" />
